title: Neural network modeling of differential binding between wild-type and mutant CTCF reveals putative binding preferences for zinc fingers 1-2
authors: Irene M. Kaplow; Abhimanyu Banerjee; Chuan Sheng Foo
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度卷积神经网络建模野生型与突变型CTCF的ChIP-seq差异，解析CTCF锌指1-2的DNA结合偏好，属于TF-DNA结合位点预测与互作机制研究，高度契合本课题。
abstract: Background Many transcription factors (TFs), such as multi zinc-finger (ZF) TFs, have multiple DNA binding domains (DBDs) with multiple components, and deciphering the DNA binding motifs of individual components is a major challenge. One example of such a TF is CCCTC-binding factor (CTCF), a TF with eleven ZFs that plays a variety of roles in transcriptional regulation, most notably anchoring DNA loops. Previous studies found that CTCF zinc fingers (ZFs) 3-7 bind CTCF’s core motif and ZFs 9-11 bind a specific upstream motif, but the motifs of ZFs 1-2 have yet to be identified. Results We developed a new approach to identifying the binding motifs of individual DBDs of a TF through analyzing chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing (ChIP-seq) experiments in which a single DBD is mutated: we train a deep convolutional neural network to predict whether wild-type TF binding sites are preserved in the mutant TF dataset and interpret the model. We applied this approach to mouse CTCF ChIP-seq data and, in addition to identifying the known binding preferences of CTCF ZFs 3-11, we identified a GAG binding motif for ZF1 and a weak ATT binding motif for ZF2. We analyzed other CTCF datasets to provide additional evidence that ZFs 1-2 interact with the motifs we identified, and we found that the presence of the motif for ZF1 is associated with Ctcf peak strength. Conclusions Our approach can be applied to any TF for which in vivo binding data from both the wild-type and mutated versions of the TF are available, and our findings provide an unprecedently comprehensive understanding of the binding preferences of CTCF’s DBDs.
abstract_zh: 背景 许多转录因子（TFs），如多锌指（ZF）转录因子，具有包含多个组件的多个DNA结合域（DBDs），而解析各个组件的DNA结合基序是一项重大挑战。此类转录因子的一个例子是CCCTC结合因子（CTCF），这是一种具有十一个锌指的转录因子，在转录调控中发挥多种作用，最显著的是锚定DNA环。先前的研究发现，CTCF锌指（ZFs）3-7结合CTCF的核心基序，ZFs 9-11结合特定的上游基序，但ZFs 1-2的基序尚未被鉴定。结果 我们开发了一种新方法，通过分析单个DBD被突变的染色质免疫沉淀测序（ChIP-seq）实验来鉴定转录因子各DBD的结合基序：我们训练一个深度卷积神经网络，以预测野生型转录因子结合位点是否在突变体转录因子数据集中保留，并解释该模型。我们将此方法应用于小鼠CTCF ChIP-seq数据，除了鉴定出CTCF ZFs 3-11的已知结合偏好外，我们还鉴定出ZF1的GAG结合基序和ZF2的弱ATT结合基序。我们分析了其他CTCF数据集，以提供额外证据表明ZFs 1-2与我们鉴定的基序相互作用，并发现ZF1基序的存在与Ctcf峰强度相关。结论 我们的方法可应用于任何具有野生型和突变型转录因子体内结合数据的转录因子，我们的发现提供了对CTCF DBDs结合偏好的前所未有的全面理解。
